summary: Counterpoint Research forecasts that DRAM demand for humanoid robot “brains” will grow 20-fold by 2030 compared with 2026, positioning robotics as a new memory growth market after AI data centers drove the HBM boom. title: 얀 르쿤의 월드 모델 'H-제파', 단·장기 계획 분리로 로봇 경로 계획 성공률 73% 달성
summary: H-JEPA is a hierarchical world model developed by researchers including Yann LeCun that separates short-horizon, low-level motion prediction from longer-horizon abstract goal planning, rather than forcing both into one latent space. In simulated maze navigation, this split raised robot path-planning success from 18% with a single-layer model to 73%, while also reducing the computation needed for planning.

title: 中 노이매트릭스, 체화 세계행동모델 'Noe-0' 기술 프리뷰 공개
summary: Shanghai AI robotics company Noematrix released a technical preview of Noe-0, an embodied World Action Model trained on real-world data to help robots understand their surroundings and choose actions in physical environments.
